terms: complex: Atlanta's own 2006 pick lottery-protected (top 14), top-3 protected in 2007, unprotected in 2008; plus a conditional Lakers/Boston pick
quote: That pick which is "lottery" protected (1-14) in 2006, has protection through No. 3 in 2007 and has no protection in 2008.
notes: which of the two picks became Rondo not stated

terms: top-5 protected in 2001, top-3 in 2002, top-1 in 2003, unprotected in 2004
quote: The Cs cannot use the pick if it's in the top 5 in 2001; top 3 in 2002 or the top pick in 2003.
a 2009 first round draft pick (top three protected)

terms: top-3 protected in 1999 (unprotected in the following two years)
quote: Under the terms of the deal, Cleveland's pick cannot be among the top three this year.

notes: ESPN calls it a conditional first-rounder without terms
